messages.author: a8c73113f8e105ae
messages.subject: FERPA compliance
parts:
Is shinyapps.io FERPA compliant?  If my app had a file that contained some educational PII (personally identifiable information), would it violate FERPA to put the app on shinyapps.io?  Obviously it would if the file were openly accessible, so assume that I have a paid account and require user authentication.

Thanks,
Paul

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] FERPA compliance
parts:
Paul,

I'm afraid I can't offer any guidance as to wether hosting your application on shinyapps.io complies with FERPA regulations. Its possible, but we have not investigated it. Typically for user with compliance concerns, we recommend hosting their own server using Shiny Server or Shiny Server Pro.

-Andy
